title: Onboarding pipeline test generates its own random slug instead of using UAT scenario input — swiftroute realm-missing inconsistent state compounds scenario unverifiability
category: test harness error + backend state inconsistency

root_causes.label: Pipeline test slug mismatch
root_causes.description: The pipeline test hardcodes `const slug = 'pl-' + randomUUID().slice(0,8)` regardless of UAT scenario input. There is no mechanism to inject the scenario's canonical slug ('swiftroute'). EO-003 (Alice Bauer can log into the SwiftRoute workspace) can therefore never be verified by this test — it always verifies a proxy tenant.

root_causes.label: Orphaned tenant DB record without matching Keycloak realm
root_causes.description: At UAT time, bpm_dev.public.tenant had slug='swiftroute' (count=1) but Keycloak GET /admin/realms/swiftroute returned 404. The saga compensate() function correctly deletes the Keycloak realm before the DB record, so the inconsistency most likely resulted from a manual or out-of-band Keycloak realm deletion (or Keycloak state reset) after the saga completed. The open ISS-0070 (background saga thread not transitioning to terminal state) may also contribute if partial saga runs fail to compensate.

evidence.pipeline_slug_code: web/tests/e2e/pipelines/onboarding-wizard.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts lines 67-68: const uid = randomUUID().slice(0, 8); const slug = 'pl-' + uid
evidence.uat_precondition_db: bpm_dev.public.tenant slug='swiftroute' count=1 at UAT time (2026-06-15T21:29:35Z)
evidence.uat_precondition_kc: Keycloak GET /admin/realms/swiftroute → 404 (Realm not found) at UAT time
evidence.db_current_state: bpm_dev.public.tenant slug='swiftroute' count=0 (cleaned up after UAT run; pl-f8db07e7 and default remain)

resolution: Root cause A (slug hardcoding): onboarding-wizard.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts:29-34,72-73 now reads INJECTED_SLUG from process.env.ONBOARDING_PIPELINE_SLUG, falling back to the old random slug only when unset. tests/specs/PIPELINE-onboarding-wizard.md:81-100 documents the env-var contract and the swiftroute/vortex/meridian slug mapping. Root cause B (orphaned tenant/Keycloak state) is covered by ISS-0070, separately RESOLVED.
verification: Batch re-triage 2026-08-10 (WF03-batch-GH280-301-triage-20260810): both root causes source-verified fixed. Note: docs/agents/UAT_RUNNER.md does not itself document the ONBOARDING_PIPELINE_SLUG env-var invocation — this is a minor doc-completeness gap, not a functional defect, and does not block closing this issue. Filed separately if warranted.
